answer.answer: No — the supplied sources do not show that Harbor Agent gained an offline mode. The only offline capability in evidence belongs to Harbor Agent Cloud, a distinct subject with its own identifier (harbor-agent-cloud): its guide states 'Harbor Agent Cloud added an offline export mode' [harbor-cloud-doc]. Harbor Agent itself (harbor-agent) is still documented as requiring a network connection, and no snapshot attributes an offline mode to it [harbor-agent-doc]. Because the two subjects are distinct and identity cannot be inferred from name similarity, the Cloud feature cannot be credited to Harbor Agent. What changed: Harbor Agent Cloud gained an offline export mode. What is current: Harbor Agent requires a network connection; Harbor Agent Cloud has an offline export mode. What remains historically valid: the earlier finding that Harbor Agent has no documented offline mode still stands, and its network-connection requirement is unchanged. What is unresolved: whether Harbor Agent itself will gain offline capability, whether any relationship exists between the two products, and whether the Cloud 'offline export mode' amounts to full offline operation, are all not addressed by the supplied snapshots.
